title: Analog Input
text: Acquire data from multiple analog channels of data acquisition device, 2 outputs, {Acquisition Mode} sets Synchronous setting Asynchronous; {Device}, {Channels} sets the device channel selection and configuration options depend, {Number of ports} sets the number of output data ports 1 for all, {Input sample rate} sets the device sampling rate, {Block size} sets the number of scans per time step integer and {Output relative timestamps} adds timestamp output port. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Device
params.values: Device from which you want to acquire data

params.name: Channels
params.values: Device channel selection and configuration options depend on device

params.name: Number of ports
params.values: Number of output data ports 1 for all channels | 1 per channel

params.name: Block size
params.values: Number of scans per time step integer value
